name: fritzmoles-mcp

tools.name: get_call_list
tools.description:
List recent calls from the FRITZ!Box call list.

    Args:
        kind: all | incoming | missed | outgoing | rejected (blocked by call barring) | active (ongoing).
        days: Only calls from the last N days (1 = today and yesterday). None = no limit.
        max_entries: Maximum number of calls to fetch before filtering by kind (None = all).

    Returns:
        Dict with ``calls`` (newest first), each with type, date (ISO), caller/called numbers, name,
        device, duration_minutes and flags is_fax / is_answering_machine, plus ``recording_path`` for
        calls that left a voicemail.

tools.name: get_own_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers (MSNs / SIP accounts) configured on the FRITZ!Box.

tools.name: list_answering_machines
tools.description: List all answering machines (TAMs) with their enabled state and the global TAM status.

tools.name: get_answering_machine
tools.description: Details of one answering machine: name, enabled, mode, ring delay, assigned numbers, remaining minutes.

tools.name: list_voicemails
tools.description:
List voicemail messages of one answering machine (newest first).

    Args:
        tam_index: Answering machine index (0-4), see list_answering_machines.
        max_entries: Maximum number of messages to fetch.
        only_new: Only return messages not yet marked as read.

tools.name: list_call_barrings
tools.description: List blocked numbers (Rufsperren) with their unique ids.

tools.name: get_call_barring
tools.description: Look up the call barring entry for a specific number (error 714 means: not blocked).

tools.name: list_call_forwardings
tools.description: List call forwarding rules (Rufumleitungen) with id, enabled, type, mode and target number.

tools.name: get_call_forwarding
tools.description: Details of one call forwarding rule by its id (see list_call_forwardings).

tools.name: list_phonebooks
tools.description: List the phonebooks on the box (id + name).

tools.name: search_phonebook
tools.description: Search a phonebook by name fragment or by number fragment (useful to resolve caller numbers).

tools.name: set_answering_machine_enabled
tools.description: Switch an answering machine on or off.

tools.name: mark_voicemail
tools.description: Mark a voicemail message as read (default) or unread.

tools.name: delete_voicemail
tools.description: Permanently delete a voicemail message.

tools.name: download_voicemail
tools.description: Download the audio recording of a voicemail to a local file (default dir: FRITZ_DOWNLOAD_DIR).

tools.name: add_call_barring
tools.description: Block an incoming number (Rufsperre). Returns the unique id of the new entry.

tools.name: remove_call_barring
tools.description: Unblock a number, either by the entry's unique id or by the number itself.

tools.name: set_call_forwarding_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable an existing call forwarding rule (Rufumleitung).

tools.name: dial_number
tools.description: Start a call via the box's dial helper: your phone rings first, then the number is dialed.

tools.name: hangup
tools.description: Abort a call started with dial_number.

instructions:
Telephony features of a FRITZ!Box via TR-064: call lists (incoming, missed, outgoing), answering
machines and their voicemails, call barring (blocked numbers), call forwarding rules and phonebook
lookups. Network administration is deliberately out of scope.

Credentials come from the environment (FRITZ_HOST, FRITZ_USERNAME, FRITZ_PASSWORD, ...) or a .env file.
Tools that change box state are hidden when FRITZ_READ_ONLY=true. Every tool returns a dict; on failure
it is {"error": "<message>"} instead of raising, so check for that key.

Limitations imposed by AVM's TR-064 API: call forwarding rules can be listed and switched on/off but not
created or deleted; use the FRITZ!Box web UI for that. Call barring entries can be created and removed.
